modeling_method: Original mesh construction from measured-scale primitive/profile geometry. Original deterministic procedural PBR maps. No extracted proprietary mesh, branding, vendor photographs or textures incorporated.

materials.origin: Original authored procedural materials in make_textures.py; seed 1707. No external texture downloads.
materials.maps: 512px RGB PNG basecolor sRGB, tangent-space OpenGL (+Y) normal linear, roughmetal linear R=255 G=roughness B=metallic. AO baked separately per asset at 512px, UV1; not multiplied into basecolor. Factors baseColor=[1,1,1,1], roughness=1, metallic=1, normalScale=1, occlusionStrength=1.
materials.repeat: UV0 wood 0.12m crossgrain and 0.60m along grain, resin/metal/rubber 0.25m axes, webbing 0.125m repeat. All materials repeat; AO UV1 unique atlas clamp intent.
